# exodus_firewall (Resource)

A set of inbound allow rules. Attach it to servers with their `firewall_ids`: once a server has a firewall, only traffic that some rule allows gets in. Outbound traffic is not filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exodus_firewall" "web" {
  name = "web"
  rules = [
    { protocol = "tcp", ports = "22", source = "203.0.113.10", description = "office SSH" },
    { protocol = "tcp", ports = "80,443" },
    { protocol = "icmp" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name shown in the panel.

### Optional

- `rules` (Attributes List) Inbound allow rules. An empty list blocks all inbound traffic to attached servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp` or `any`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Note shown in the panel, up to 100 characters.
- `ports` (String) TCP/UDP only: `"22"`, `"80,443"` or a range `"8000-8100"`. Omit for all ports.
- `source` (String) IPv4 address or CIDR the traffic may come from. Omit for anywhere.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import exodus_firewall.web <firewall id>
```
